newsitem.title: UK: UK's John David Sports flotation priced 285p/share.
newsitem.headline: UK's John David Sports flotation priced 285p/share.

text.p: UK leisurewear retailer John David Sports Plc said on Tuesday its flotation was priced at 285p per share, giving it a market capitalisation of 132.6 million stg.
The placing price represented a multiple of 27.7 times the company's earnings per ordinary share of 10.3p for the year ended March 31.
Under the placing agreement, existing shareholders will sell about 10.4 million ordinary shares.
The company will issue 3.5 million new ordinary shares to raise 8.9 million stg for the company, net of expenses.
John David said it would have some 46.5 million ordinary shares in issue immediately following the placing.
Dealing in the shares on the London Stock Exchange was expected to begin on October 22.
BZW acted as sponsor and financial adviser for the company's flotation.
